title: pleurospermum cicutarium
intro: Pleurospermum cicutarium, commonly known as Chervil or Shepherd's Needle, is a plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion and relieve symptoms of menopause, such as hot flashes. The therapeutic actions of Pleurospermum cicutarium include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and coumarins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and may help to promote relaxation and reduce stress.
